title: Custom Mystery 1
story:
A scientist creates an AI robot that predicts which student will win a quiz. The robot predicts that Sara will win.

Before the quiz starts, the scientist discovers that the AI was trained using Sara’s previous quiz results, but it knows nothing about the other students.

The AI still says, “Sara will definitely win!”

What is the biggest problem with this AI prediction?
puzzle:

answers: The AI has incomplete information. It only knows Sara’s past results, so it cannot fairly or confidently predict that she will definitely win.
